question: Can an agent learn a useful unfamiliar feature/outcome rule by consuming read-only public transitions generated by an independent external simulated actor, while never initiating its own calibration interventions?
environment: Existing NovelFeatureWorld third_rule only; novel diagonal feature->progress relation, hand-designed known in benchmark harness, not in learner.

passive_random_240.selection: uniform random among public handles using hash-seeded actor RNG, no truth access

passive_old_policy_240.selection: previously trained normal NumericOutcomeMemory.choose from public frame, no truth access

source_episodes.small_random_24: exact first 24 events of random_240; same initial data

actor_accounting: Every simulated external actor action is counted including damage. Learner generates zero actions to acquire these events. Do NOT describe total human/ecological cost as zero.
learner: PassiveOutcomeArchive stores before-action-after public frames, recomputes sensor deltas, disallows duplicate episodes, refuses hidden metadata, digest-verifies exact replay. Independently constructs NumericOutcomeMemory via public events. No hidden world name or rule labels supplied.
predeclared_policy: Guarded kNN action selection: at least 5 nearest public events, predicted progress >=0.6 and predicted damage exactly 0; otherwise abstain, counting task as unfinished. Other policy uses raw model.choose without guard.
control_rules: Same generated held-out third-rule tasks across every method
No hidden world/mapping in any learner/model calls
Independent external simulator actor does choose training action; candidate has no ability to initiate observation
Oracle uses private truth only for unequal upper bound
All six seeds fixed now; reserved may not be described as blind after its first execution
No parameter tuning against reserved outputs; document failures
Not independent naturalistic world: domain and numeric features engineered; human oversight required for any promotions
out_of_scope: passive observation of a genuine real human
deployment integration with AthenZ or Synveil
